g.text: How much history identifies an exact address with time to issue?

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Cells show the share of cues with an exact legal address and ≥130 cycles of lead at one proposal per cue.

g.text: Page-relative legality is checked at the cue. Models share capacity and training targets within each horizon. Source: scores.csv
